}}'''Nerrine''' was a [[Da'shain]] [[Aiel]], later [[Jenn Aiel]], woman who lived during the [[Breaking of the World]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nerrine}}

==History==
Nerrine was the mother of [[Colline]], [[Charlin]] and [[Alijha]]. When Colline was abducted by bandits, then rescued by a group of Aiel including her brothers, Nerrine met the returning group. Her brother Charlin was killed during the rescue.{{ref/book|4|25}}

She lived during the period of time where the Da'shain Aiel experienced their second division and became the Jenn Aiel.
